quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on embracing physicality and maintaining team identity

quotes.quote: Just knowing the teams are going to try to be physical with us and then embracing the physicality. And being physical with us, we be physical too. It's just something the coach always tells us and just not going away from our game while being physical too.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels defines the team's selfless passing and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: if you get the ball, there's one more man open to you like an extra extra pass
quotes.quote: If you get the ball, there's one more man open to you like an extra extra pass kind of thing to make sure you do that. Or even like a layup and then being the passing back to me kind of thing. So, just not mad, not caring who scores, just all having fun together.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the team ball movement: If you get the ball, there is one more man open to you like an extra extra pass kind of thing to make sure you do that. Just not mad, not caring who scores, just all having fun together.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the team's commitment to shooting and practice
quotes.excerpt: we got a bunch of good shooters. We always putting in our work on the threes
quotes.quote: I don't know to be honest, I didn't even know we shot 53s, but we got a bunch of good shooters. We always putting in our work on the threes after practice, before, or on our own time. So, I don't think we're bad shooters at all. It just seems like with Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball, they shot 30s on the 50-year. But again, it worked, they were making the shots, so I mean, we can't be mad at it. That's what they were giving, they take it.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the team shooting: We got a bunch of good shooters. We always putting in our work on the threes after practice, before, or on our own time. So, I do not think we are bad shooters at all.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his contract extension and love for Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I just love the place I'm at, I love Minnesota, like the fans, the atmosphere
quotes.quote: I just love the place I'm at, I love Minnesota, like the fans, the atmosphere, just everything. Being here for seven years already, I mean, it's just a no-brainer adding another year. You know, it's not going to matter or anything about it. I'm actually super excited to stay here and just continue to wear this jersey.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his commitment to the Timberwolves: I love the place I am at, I love Minnesota. Being here for seven years already, it is just a no-brainer adding another year. I am actually super excited to stay here.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels expresses his happiness regarding his recent contract extension and his commitment to the Minnesota Timberwolves.
